core_obligations: Use stability under base change and the choice of beta to reduce the lemma to the equality c'_p(Q) cap alpha = c_p(Z -> X, F) cap alpha for arbitrary alpha (proof lines 11184-11198).

Run the chain of equalities: c'_p(Q) via the construction, c_p(E -> W_infinity, Q|_{W_infinity}) via agreement, the base change identification, commutation with i'_infinity^*, the common restriction over b^{-1}(A^1_X), the replacement of W'_infinity by W'_0 via rational equivalence, bivariance, and W'_0 = Z (proof lines 11200-11244).
proof_roadmap: Base change reduction and the choice of beta (proof lines 11184-11198).
First four equalities: construction, agreement, base change, bivariance (proof lines 11200-11228).
Fifth and sixth: the common restriction and rational equivalence at infinity (proof lines 11230-11242).
Last two equalities and conclusion (proof lines 11242-11244).
difficulty_reason: Assume (S, delta), X, Z, b : W -> P^1_X, Q, T and p satisfy the assumptions of Lemma labelled lemma-localized-chern-pre, and let F be a perfect object of D(O_X) such that Q restricts to the pullback of F over b^{-1}(A^1_X), F is zero or finite locally free of rank < p off Z in degree 0, and Q and F satisfy assumption (3) of Situation labelled situation-loc-chern; the lemma asserts that P'_p(Q), resp. c'_p(Q), equals P_p(Z -> X, F), resp. c_p(Z -> X, F) (statement lines 11164-11182). The proof first notes that the assumptions are stable under base change along X' -> X locally of finite type, reducing to the equality after capping with an arbitrary alpha in CH_k(X), and chooses beta in CH_{k+1}(W) restricting to the flat pullback of alpha as in the construction of C in Lemma labelled lemma-gysin-at-infty (proof lines 11184-11198). The body is a chain of eight equalities for c'_p(Q) cap alpha: the construction of c'_p(Q) in Lemma labelled lemma-localized-chern-pre, the replacement of the localized class by c_p(E -> W_infinity, Q|_{W_infinity}) by Lemma labelled lemma-loc-chern-agree, the base change identification of E = W'_infinity -> W_infinity with the pullback of W' -> W using Lemma labelled lemma-base-change-loc-chern, commutation with i'_infinity^*, the observation that c_p(W' -> W, Q) and c_p(Z' -> X, F) restrict to the same class over b^{-1}(A^1_X) so that (i'_infinity)^* annihilates the difference, the replacement of W'_infinity by W'_0 using that both are pullbacks of rationally equivalent divisors as in Lemma labelled lemma-support-cap-effective-Cartier, another use of bivariance, and finally W'_0 = Z with i_0^* beta = alpha (proof lines 11200-11244). Tracking which of the eight steps is base change, which is the defining property of C, and which is rational equivalence of the special and generic fibres is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
